# Terms

## Defined terms

### sour rye -- Ch.2 (heading)
**Canonical definition:** Bread raised by a starter instead of yeast.

### starter -- foreword (book term)
**Canonical definition:** A living mix of flour and water that raises the dough.

### timing -- word rule (usage)
**Canonical definition:** Used only for when a step happens, never for how long it lasts.
